alerts.reason: Applied estimates that export regulations could reduce fiscal 2023 China net sales by up to $2.5 billion (D). Display customers had also cut equipment investment (A). Together these pressures support a forecast that consolidated net sales growth stays above −5% year over year in the preceding quarter and falls to −5% or worse in the quarter starting January 30. Timing is uncertain because Applied gives only an annual estimate for China.
